evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~423-426 °C, physically implausible versus T702 ~81 °C and column top ~63-66 °C; drifts monotonically upward with no effect on the rest of the column
Top temperatures creeping up (63.6->66.4 °C) while T705 stays flat ~63.3-63.4 °C, indicating progressive loss of top-of-column separation (light-key depletion)
Reflux and distillate flows steady (~0.37/0.21 L/h), ratio noisy 4.9-5.9 but stable
Pressure ~498-500 mbar and differential pressures steady, so no blockage or flooding

args.missing_evidence: A distillate composition (GC) sample, and an independent reboiler temperature reading or sensor check to confirm T701 is a faulty/miscalibrated channel rather than a real process condition.
